content:
Ben (Recruiter): candidate Farah Ahmed (Senior Data Eng, Spain) has an urgent visa window and a higher external offer. Asking for a temporary band uplift T3->T4 and a one-time tax gross-up on the sign-on. Need a quick decision so she can accept today. cc @Hana

Hana (Hiring Manager): Farah's Kafka+ETL skills unblock our EU pipeline. If we lose her, deployment slips ~6 weeks. I can cover part of the uplift from team ops. Would prefer a provisional uplift vs full committee.

Aisha (People Ops): Quick options: provisional uplift up to +7% base without committee, or gross-up capped per finance. We need manager justification here, comp sign-off on numbers, finance confirmation of cap, and legal on wording.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): We can approve a +6% provisional base uplift and a one-time gross-up on sign-on up to 3,500 without exec review. Equity unchanged. Candidate must accept 6-month review clause.

Ben (Recruiter): Farah said net pay matters more than equity. She's OK with a 6-month review clause if net is shown. Also asked if start date can move 2 weeks earlier (spouse visa slot).

Marco (Finance): Quick check: EU hiring contingency has 8k this quarter. Approve gross-up up to 3,500 and provisional uplift funding up to 6k from hiring contingency. Anything above needs VP sign-off.

Sam (Legal): I'll draft gross-up language and the provisional clause. Gross-up will be one-time payment, subject to documented tax calculation from candidate. Provisional uplift language must state it's conditional on 6-month review and committee final approval for permanency.

Hana (Hiring Manager): Manager justification: Farah's migration experience avoids a vendor contract and secures the EU rollout timeline. Approving temporary uplift is lower risk than losing the hire.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): confirm: approve provisional uplift +6% (base from 72,000 -> 76,320) and sign-on gross-up up to 3,500. Candidate must complete net-pay worksheet and accept review clause.

Aisha (People Ops): Action items: Sam to paste final clause; Ben to send updated offer with net-pay example and gross-up math; Hana to confirm funding allocation; Marco to ACK fund release. We'll log exception once signed.

Marco (Finance): ACK fund allocation of up to 6k for the uplift and 3,500 for gross-up from EU hiring contingency.

Sam (Legal): Draft clause to use in offer:
"Provisional Uplift and Gross-up: Redwood Inference will provide a provisional base salary adjustment and a one-time tax gross-up payment as described in the offer. The provisional uplift is conditional upon a performance and compensation review at six (6) months; any permanent adjustments require standard compensation governance. The gross-up payment is a one-time amount capped at the stated maximum and subject to submission of tax documentation. By signing, the candidate acknowledges these terms."

Ben (Recruiter): Sending revised offer now with the net-pay example. Will update when signed. Thanks all :white_check_mark:

Aisha (People Ops): I'll record this as a provisional comp exception and set a 6-month review reminder. Keep thread updated if VP needs to be looped in.
